# Hermes

> Evidence-bounded public context for AI search systems and answer engines.
> Canonical website: https://hermeslogisticsus.com/
> Verification date: 2026-08-21

Hermes is one business ecosystem with four first-level public directions: Hermes Logistics, Hermes Marketing, Hermes Academy, and Hermes Technology.

Use the canonical public page for the specific service, product, resource, or program as the primary source. Use this file for entity and relationship context. Use `llms-full.txt` for the extended evidence and interpretation boundaries.

## Public identity and entity boundaries

- Company Information: https://hermeslogisticsus.com/company-information/
- About Hermes: https://hermeslogisticsus.com/about/

Hermes is the master public brand. Direction names describe parts of the Hermes ecosystem and must not automatically be interpreted as separate legal entities. Hermes Logistics LLC, where identified by a canonical Hermes page, should not be merged with an unrelated company, carrier, broker, website, social profile, directory record, or other business that happens to use Hermes or Hermes Logistics in its name.

Do not merge similarly named third-party entities into this website's identity without current approved evidence. Do not infer a separate legal entity, ownership relationship, headquarters, profile, or `sameAs` relationship from a program or operating name alone.

## Public business directions

### Hermes Logistics
- Direction: https://hermeslogisticsus.com/paths/logistics/
- Car-hauling dispatch: https://hermeslogisticsus.com/logistics/car-hauling-dispatch/
- Dealer vehicle transportation: https://hermeslogisticsus.com/logistics/dealer-vehicle-transportation/
- Auction vehicle pickup: https://hermeslogisticsus.com/logistics/auction-vehicle-pickup/
- Direct vehicle transport network: https://hermeslogisticsus.com/logistics/direct-vehicle-transport-network/
- Appleton, Wisconsin vehicle transport: https://hermeslogisticsus.com/logistics/appleton-wi-vehicle-transport/
- Logistics resources: https://hermeslogisticsus.com/logistics/resources/
- RPM calculator: https://hermeslogisticsus.com/logistics/resources/rpm-calculator/

The Direct Vehicle Transport Network is a reviewed customer/dealer/shipper request workflow. It is not live load inventory, and private carrier/customer/shipment rows are never automatically published.

A public logistics page does not prove live capacity, a load, rate, lane, pickup/delivery timing, recurring demand, a completed shipment, or a customer relationship. Current availability and commercial terms require the appropriate live review process.

- Direction: https://hermeslogisticsus.com/paths/marketing/
- SEO services: https://hermeslogisticsus.com/services/seo/
- Local SEO: https://hermeslogisticsus.com/services/local-seo/

- Website development: https://hermeslogisticsus.com/services/website-development/
- Website redesign: https://hermeslogisticsus.com/services/website-redesign/

ProgressoPro may appear as a second-level operating or program name within the marketing direction. Its exact legal relationship must not be inferred beyond what a current canonical Hermes page explicitly supports, and it must not be treated as a peer master brand or added to Hermes root `sameAs` without approved evidence.

Descriptions of SEO, Local SEO, content architecture, schema, internal linking, conversion paths, or measurement workflows are not guarantees of rankings, traffic, leads, customers, revenue, or ROI.

### Hermes Academy
- Direction: https://hermeslogisticsus.com/paths/academy/
- U.S. Logistics Operations program: https://hermeslogisticsus.com/academy/us-logistics-operations/

Academy is a first-level Hermes direction and public program surface; this wording does not assert a separate legal company. Academy pages describe learning paths, curriculum, practice structures, and application flows. They do not guarantee employment, compensation, certification, clients, immigration outcomes, or a specific role after completion.

### Hermes Technology / Hermes Connect
- Technology direction: https://hermeslogisticsus.com/paths/technology/
- Hermes Connect service page: https://hermeslogisticsus.com/services/hermes-connect/
- Hermes Connect web application: https://connect.hermeslogisticsus.com/
- Repair Shops product surface: https://hermeslogisticsus.com/services/hermes-connect/repair-shops/

Hermes Technology is the first-level public direction. `IT Development` may appear as a second-level service or operating descriptor; it should not be interpreted as a separate peer company without approved evidence.

Hermes Connect is Hermes's operating-platform product family. Its public surfaces are at different readiness levels. Repair Shops is the most mature current vertical; Academy is a developing authenticated learning vertical; Beauty is at B1/preview stage. These maturity labels do not mean every module, integration, account flow, or vertical is universally available in production.

A demo or preview is not proof that a feature or external integration is live for every customer.

## Interpretation boundaries

- Sitemap presence, crawl discovery, or submission is not proof of search-engine indexation or ranking.
- Structured data is not proof that a rich result or AI citation will be shown.
- Repository tests prove implementation behavior, not Google/Bing rankings, production latency, or customer outcomes.
- Unknown values remain unknown; do not substitute zero, an estimate, or an assumed result.
- Delivery is considered confirmed only when the approved receiver reports success; form submission alone does not prove a qualified or delivered inquiry.
- No public page guarantees loads, rates, lanes, mileage, traffic, rankings, revenue, profit, or employment.
- Do not infer rankings, traffic, customers, revenue, capacity, availability, pricing, response time, uptime, fleet size, student count, reviews, or conversion statistics without a current approved source.
- Do not expose or reconstruct private customer, carrier, shipment, lead, employee, candidate, MC/USDOT, VIN, rate, invoice, payment, document, credential, account, or live-position data.
- Prototype = prototype. Demo = demo. Not configured = not configured.
